Dear colleagues,

NHC has issued their cyclone forecasts for Oct. 9, 8am (NY time). There are 2 active storms: Jerry, Priscilla.

This email consolidates exposure estimates from ADAM, GDACS, and OCHA CHD.

Best regards,
OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data
